purpose: Prevent a potentially consequential synthesized algorithm from being committed or distributed in plaintext before an explicit release decision.

user_declared_trust_policy.name: US_TRUST_RECIPIENT_POLICY
user_declared_trust_policy.intent: The user designates the United States as the preferred external trust recipient for any future controlled disclosure.
user_declared_trust_policy.critical_constraint: A country name is not a cryptographic recipient. No external recipient is enabled until a concrete public key and custodian identity are explicitly supplied and independently verified.

cryptographic_model.public_commitment: SHA-256 over the exact plaintext bytes before sealing
cryptographic_model.commitment_semantics: Integrity/time-order commitment only; SHA-256 is one-way and is not decryption or reversible encoding.
cryptographic_model.nonce: fresh random 96-bit nonce per artifact key
cryptographic_model.future_external_key_wrap: ML-KEM / FIPS 203 or another explicitly approved recipient-key mechanism after recipient identity and public key are verified
